summary: Captain Caine is a ruthless sea commander who works for the Organization. His job is to oversee water-based operations.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Captain Caine was first seen when the Huntik team were on a mission to recover four Amulets. Although Lok, Sophie and Dante recovered the first three, the fourth was taken by Caine. After a fierce underwater battle, Caine returned to ground level where he gave Gregor the Amulet of Dark Triton. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Caine arrived with some Suits to capture the Huntik team after they were trapped on the mysterious island. Although on the upper hand, Caine and his team were defeated by the Huntik team with some help from Montehue and Tersly. [Island of the Titans][The Headless Horseman]

Caine later met the Huntik team again in the City of Ys, traveling on Megladeath alongside Dr. Rickman.[Seekers of Ys] During the battle, Caine invoked Land Shark and gained the upper hand but the group were ultimately defeated and he was arrested by the Huntik Foundation. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

Captain Caine is a ruthless sea commander who works for the Organization. His job is to oversee water-based operations. 

== History ==
Captain Caine was first seen when the Huntik team were on a mission to recover four Amulets. Although Lok, Sophie and Dante recovered the first three, the fourth was taken by Caine. After a fierce underwater battle, Caine returned to ground level where he gave Gregor the Amulet of Dark Triton. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Caine arrived with some Suits to capture the Huntik team after they were trapped on the mysterious island. Although on the upper hand, Caine and his team were defeated by the Huntik team with some help from Montehue and Tersly. [Island of the Titans][The Headless Horseman]

Caine later met the Huntik team again in the City of Ys, traveling on Megladeath alongside Dr. Rickman.[Seekers of Ys] During the battle, Caine invoked Land Shark and gained the upper hand but the group were ultimately defeated and he was arrested by the Huntik Foundation. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

'''Captain Caine''' is a ruthless sea commander who works for [[the Organization]]. His job is to oversee water-based operations. 

== History ==
Captain Caine was first seen when the Huntik team were on a mission to recover four [[Amulets]]. Although [[Lok]], [[Sophie]] and [[Dante]] recovered the first three, the fourth was taken by Caine. After a fierce underwater battle, Caine returned to ground level where he gave [[Gregor]] the Amulet of [[Dark Triton]]. {{Source|The Treasures of Alexandria}}

Caine arrived with some [[Suits]] to capture the Huntik team after they were trapped on the mysterious island. Although on the upper hand, Caine and his team were defeated by the Huntik team with some help from [[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]]. {{Source|Island of the Titans}}{{Source|The Headless Horseman}}

Caine later met the Huntik team again in the City of [[Ys]], traveling on [[Megladeath]] alongside [[Dr. Rickman]].{{source|Seekers of Ys}} During the battle, Caine invoked [[Land Shark]] and gained the upper hand but the group were ultimately defeated and he was arrested by the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|The Lost City of Casterwill}}

== Abilities ==
Caine is an adept tactician, and is skilled at planning water-based missions for [[the Organization]]. A powerful swimmer, he possesses a variety of water-based [[Titans]] and powers, most notably his favored Titan and mode of transport, [[Megladeath]].
